site.name: Villa Solmare
site.title: Villa Solmare — Clifftop Coastal Sanctuary | Bay of Bengal, Bangladesh
site.description: An ultra-luxury coastal stone sanctuary with panoramic Bay of Bengal views, private terrace, four bedroom suites and tropical garden, 300 metres from Inani Beach. Sleeps 8.

arrival.tagline: A stone sanctuary above the sea, on the scenic southern coast of Bangladesh.

intro.heading: Two centuries of architectural heritage, restored for quiet luxury by the sea.
intro.text: Villa Solmare stands on the coastal clifftops overlooking the Bay of Bengal. Today it has four luxury bedroom suites, three artisanal bathrooms and an expansive terrace facing west, so every evening ends with the golden sun setting into the ocean.

rooms.name: The living room
rooms.text: Linen sofas, hand-carved stone hearth and timber beams overhead. An arch leads straight into the kitchen.

rooms.name: The kitchen
rooms.text: Artisanal hand-painted tiles, brass cookware and a long solid wood table, with a bowl of fresh citrus from the coastal garden.

rooms.name: The main bedroom
rooms.text: A linen canopy bed and French windows opening onto the terrace overlooking the Bay of Bengal. It is one of four bedrooms.

items.label: Full gourmet kitchen with modern appliances
Luxury Egyptian cotton linen and bath towels
Sea-view terrace facing west over Bay of Bengal
Private sea boat trips & deep sea cruising

area.heading: Around the house
area.text: The villa stands at the end of a private lane above Inani Beach, framed by lush coastal greenery and minutes from the ocean.

guests.heading: What our guests remember.
guests.source: from stays booked direct and through luxury travel partners

items.author: Tanvir Ahmed
items.quote: We had dinner on the terrace every night watching the sunset into the Bay of Bengal. The children didn't want to leave.

items.author: Farhana Rahman
items.quote: The private chef was the best present for our anniversary. The architectural detailing is world-class.

items.author: Zubair & Nabila
items.quote: The morning ocean breeze and the golden light in the kitchen are worth the trip on their own. Unmatched tranquility.

items.author: Rezaul Karim
items.quote: Even more beautiful than the photos. Quiet, cool in the afternoon, and cared for in every single detail.

items.author: David & Sarah Campbell
items.quote: Villa Solmare on the southern coast was the highlight of our visit to South Asia. Exceptional warmth and hospitality.

items.author: Nusrat Jahan
items.quote: Four minutes to the beach and not a sound at night except the gentle waves. Exactly what our family needed.

items.author: Mahmudul Hasan
items.quote: Three families, eight people, and still everyone found a quiet corner. Sunset from the terrace was pure magic.

items.author: Ayesha Siddiqa
items.quote: The private boat trip they arranged along Marine Drive was phenomenal. Impeccable host and spotless house.

items.author: Kazi Tariq
items.quote: Clear instructions, a spotless sanctuary and a host who answered within minutes. Best luxury experience in Bangladesh.

items.author: Marcus Weber
items.quote: Sunset from the terrace, every single evening. We stopped making plans after the second day. Truly sublime.

items.q: What are the check-in and checkout times?
items.a: Check-in is from 3:00 PM and checkout by 11:00 AM. If the booking calendar allows, we are happy to adjust to your travel schedule.
Two nights on weekdays, three nights on weekends and peak holiday seasons.

items.q: What is the currency and are there hidden taxes?
items.a: All prices are in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT ৳). Government taxes and hospitality services are confirmed clearly upfront with zero hidden charges.
Well-behaved family pets are welcome upon prior confirmation.
A car via scenic Marine Drive is easiest, and there is private secure parking for 4 cars. We can also arrange private luxury chauffeur transfer from Cox's Bazar Airport or Chittagong.
